bank.name: Montgomery County Food Bank
bank.description: Montgomery County Food Bank collects, sorts, and distributes food through community partners across Montgomery County, Texas. Volunteer opportunities include sorting food, rescuing produce, and preparing food boxes. Bushel listings are a snapshot; register separately with VolunteerHub to reserve a place with the food bank.
bank.address: 1 Food for Life Way, Conroe, TX 77385
bank.hours: Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM-5:00 PM; Friday: 8:00 AM-4:00 PM. Volunteer shift times vary.

shifts.title: Produce Rescue Center (PM)
shifts.instructions: Oct 26, 1:00-4:00 PM Central. Arrive 10 minutes early at 1 Food for Life Way, Conroe, TX 77385. Ages 12+; under 16 with an adult. Refrigerated room: bring a coat, gloves and warm headwear. Register separately on VolunteerHub; a Bushel booking does not reserve an external slot. https://mcfoodbank.volunteerhub.com/vv2/event/32fb545a-9d5d-476a-8127-e8c4621e3456

shifts.title: Evening Volunteer Shift
shifts.instructions: Oct 27, 5:00-7:00 PM Central. Arrive 10 minutes early via Welcome Center, 1 Food for Life Way, Conroe. After 5:05 PM, reschedule. Ages 12+; under 16 with adult; under 18 needs guardian waiver. Bring warm layers; wear closed-toe/back shoes. Complete VolunteerHub registration/waiver separately; Bushel does not reserve external slots. https://mcfoodbank.volunteerhub.com/vv2/event/26c13c3d-8a03-4f49-b73d-59fa2447b82a
